subject: Revert update of RedisModuleEvent_MasterLinkChange (#289)
reason: The change only renames a compatibility macro in redismodule.h (RedisModuleEvent_PrimaryLinkChange back to RedisModuleEvent_MasterLinkChange) and updates tests/modules/hooks.c to use the restored name. Both names are preprocessor aliases for the same ValkeyModuleEvent_PrimaryLinkChange struct, so the change is purely compile-time source compatibility for external modules: the compiled hooks.so and the server behave identically on both builds, every event subscription and callback is unchanged at runtime, and no command reply, replication, persistence, or module behavior differs.
